textBodies: André Rieu and his Netherlands-based Johann Strauss Orchestra—not to be confused with the Vienna Johann Strauss Orchestra—make an unusual and unexplained cut, omitting the material between bar 49 and the cello solo at bar 67. A similar excision occurs in the corresponding passage within the Coda, where the music jumps abruptly from the double barline at measure 247 directly to the solo section at bar 472.
